depiction.primary_object: capital letter S with short vertical ticks top and bottom

readings.meaning: money, payment, or currency (dollar / peso sign)

ambiguity: Almost none; at tiny sizes it could briefly look like the letter S or digit 5, or collide with dollar-inside-circle / banknote icons in the same set.

example_tasks.task: Move $1,500 from checking into the high-yield savings account
Get $300 in small bills for tipping on the Mexico trip
Update my freelance day rate for 2026 client proposals
Settle the Splitwise balance from the Tahoe cabin weekend
Submit the out-of-pocket reimbursement claim to the FSA portal
Send my share to Dave before Friday
Finalize the numbers for next quarter
Put the leftover cash envelope in the safe
Figure out how much cash we can safely pull from the emergency fund this month
Compare foreign exchange rates at the credit union versus pulling pesos from an ATM
Check whether the security deposit refund from our old landlord ever hit the joint account

example_tasks_es: Transferirle a mamá los $800 de la tanda
Ajustar el presupuesto mensual después del aumento de la renta
Cambiar dólares en la casa de cambio antes del vuelo del jueves
example_tasks_ru: Перевести хозяину за квартиру до десятого числа
Сверить семейный бюджет за сентябрь в таблице
Снять наличные доллары в банкомате перед поездкой в Стамбул

context_tasks.task: Call Vanguard about the 401k rollover paperwork
Download the 1099-INT PDFs from all three banks
Set up autopay on the new Visa card
Read chapter 4 of The Psychology of Money

near_misses.task: Order a cheap HDMI cable for the bedroom TV
Replace the torn leather wallet before dad's birthday
Water the money tree in the living room corner
Escape the dollar signs in the bash deployment script
Buy a new shredder for old statements
Pay off the car loan early

reasoning: A clean dollar/peso currency sign ($), universally understood as money, payment, price, or budget. It is one of the highest-utility icons in a task manager because paying people, moving money, budgeting, and settling expenses are everyday tasks across personal and work life.
